import sys

def count_returnable_rooms(t, test_cases):
    results = []
    for n, s in test_cases:
        # Initialize visited array
        visited = [False] * n
        
        # Function to perform DFS
        def dfs(start):
            stack = [start]
            while stack:
                current = stack.pop()
                if not visited[current]:
                    visited[current] = True
                    next_room = (current + 1) % n if s[current] == '>' or s[current] == '-' else (current - 1) % n
                    prev_room = (current - 1) % n if s[current] == '<' or s[current] == '-' else (current + 1) % n
                    if not visited[next_room] and (s[current] == '>' or s[current] == '-'):
                        stack.append(next_room)
                    if not visited[prev_room] and (s[current] == '<' or s[current] == '-'):
                        stack.append(prev_room)
        
        # Perform DFS from each room
        for i in range(n):
            if not visited[i]:
                dfs(i)
        
        # Count the number of connected components
        returnable_rooms = sum(visited)
        results.append(returnable_rooms)
    
    return results
